nodes.label: Query: WorkerManager connection explanation
nodes.rationale: WorkerManager coordinates task dispatching to chunkWorker.js Web Workers for off-thread terrain generation, lighting calculations, and greedy meshing. Worker tasks rely on voxel block characteristics defined in blocks.json and exposed via BlockRegistry.js. worldActions.js (Zustand state store) bridges this by evaluating block changes on the main thread and importing workerPool.js to trigger async worker rebuilds.
